title: Continental Steel / Apex Metals: A$870m takeover bid
summary: Continental Steel lodges an off-market takeover bid for Apex Metals at A$3.20 per share cash, a 27.0% premium to the undisturbed close.

title: TechVision Group: A$120m placement at $4.85
summary: TechVision Group raises A$120m via fully underwritten institutional placement at A$4.85, a 6.3% discount to last close, to fund the acquisition of DataStream Pty Ltd.

title: Axiom Corp / Brightfield UK: GBP780m scheme
summary: Axiom Corp announces a firm offer for Brightfield UK at 440p per share, a 24.6% premium to the undisturbed close of 353p.
